V1_failure: Enzymatic NO secretion 0.10 pmol/cm²/s vs 1.0 threshold. Substrate (L-arginine) depletion.
V2_mechanism: DETA-NONOate (diethylenetriamine NONOate) — chemical NO donor embedded in catheter polymer. Releases NO via thermal decomposition (not enzymatic). Half-life ~20h at 37°C (published).
why_different: V1: enzymatic (eNOS enzyme + L-arginine substrate → NO). V2: chemical (DETA-NONOate → thermal decomposition → NO, no substrate required). Different rate-limiting step, different failure mode.

frozen_criterion.toxicity_constraint: Total NO release over 30 days < 10 µmol/cm² (published toxicity threshold for NO in tissue)
frozen_criterion.failure_threshold: If NO release < 1.0 pmol/cm²/s at any point in 30 days, OR if total NO > toxicity threshold, FAIL
